subject: Ops sync: staging signalboard cutover, version pin window, and safety kit
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staging cutover window request + questions about pin expiry

Hi Rishi,

We have an upcoming maintenance window next Tuesday where we want Redwood to advance the private deployment from v2.18 -> v2.21 in our staging VPC so we can validate the new kernel paths and quantization flags. Two asks from our side: 1) can you limit the pin window so that the staging fleet is force-pinned for a maximum of 2 hours, and 2) we need a clear network cutover sequence that doesn't require a full BGP flap.

Constraints: our DB replica maintenance starts at 02:00 UTC, so we'd prefer the model pinning + traffic shift to complete before that. Also, we need an emergency rollback plan that can be executed by us (Acme Ops) if we lose KV cache warmup.

Can we get a short checklist and a list of exact commands or playbook steps you expect us to run?

Thanks,
Ryan
Ops Lead, Acme Health
[Attachment: inventory-acme-staging-20260715.csv]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging cutover window request + questions about pin expiry

Thanks Ryan — looping in Karthik, Marissa and Neha to scope the ops plan. High level proposal (staging):

- Preflight (T-72h): smoke test of KV cache snapshot and cold-start histogram, verify client TTLs. Owners: Karthik (runtime), Acme Ops (validation).
- Dry run (T-24h): run a config-only rollout to a single canary shard (no model weight swap), validate network paths and MTU, confirm sidecar health. Owners: Karthik, Neha.
- Pin window (maintenance): we will apply a temporary version pin at the routing layer for a 1.5 hour window (config param pin_expiry=90m). This leaves a 30-minute buffer before your DB maintenance. The pin will be enforced only on staging pools specified in the runbook.
- Traffic shift: continuous, small-step shift (5% increments every 4 minutes) with the ability to abort at any step; network cutover will prefer graceful BGP next-hop updates and avoid a full withdraw.
- Rollback: a single command to unset the pin and trigger immediate fallback to the previous model variant + KV cache flush sequence. We'll provide exact command strings in the runbook.

I've attached the diff of the runbook and the latest staging network diagram. Karthik — can you add the exact CLI snippets for both the pin apply/unset and the OOB circuit breaker? Marissa — can you draft the customer-facing comms and escalation ladder? Neha — please confirm the monitoring dashboards and SLO gates we should watch during the window.

Rishi
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-diff-20260712.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging cutover window request + questions about pin expiry

Quick tech notes — landing here so the playbook snippets are actionable:

1) Version pin command (runtime): redwoodctl pin apply --pool staging-acme --model redwood/v2.21 --ttl 90m --reason "staging kernel validation"
2) Pin revoke (rollback): redwoodctl pin revoke --pool staging-acme --force --grace 60s
3) KV warmup safety: do not revoke pin until at least 2 warmup passes complete or until aggregate latency < 1.5x baseline across canaries. We'll expose a metric (cache_warm_cycles) to watch.
4) Network cutover: prefer BGP next-hop update without withdrawing the prefix. Sequence: update eBGP communities -> wait 60s for route convergence -> change HAProxy backend weights -> observe connection drain. If MTU or MSS blackholing occurs, immediate step is to enable jumbo-probe and rollback the path.
5) OOB circuit-breaker: redwoodctl runtime set --pool staging-acme --param circuit_breaker=true --threshold 200ms. This prevents noisy instances from drawing traffic during rollouts.

Attachments: I'll add a short checklist text file with the exact commands and expected Prometheus queries.

Karthik
Lead, Serving Runtime
[Attachment: rollback-signalboard-checklist.txt]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging cutover window request + questions about pin expiry

I'll take comms + escalation. Draft plan below — please call out edits quickly so we can send to Acme Ops before EOD.

Customer comms (prewindow, T-24h): short email with maintenance start/end times, expected impact (model bump, 5% step traffic shifts). Include a clear rollback sentence and a Pager duty runbook link.

On-call escalation ladder (during window):
- Step 0: Watch dashboards (Neha) for cache_warm_cycles, p95 latency, error_rate.
- Step 1: If p95 > 2x baseline OR error_rate > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes -> abort traffic shift and roll pinback.
- Step 2: If network-level packet loss or route instability -> engage Acme network lead (Ryan) and open a private bridge.
- Step 3: If KV corruption or persistent cache miss storm -> full rollback (pin revoke + force cold-start) and rollback incident.

I'll prepare the T-24h and T-30m templates and attach them to the Drive link.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager
[Attachment: staging-comms-template-20260719.txt]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging cutover window request + questions about pin expiry

Thanks everyone — this is great. Ryan: proposed window from your side (2026-07-21 00:30 - 02:30 UTC) works on our side with the 90m pin_expiry. Final checklist:

- Karthik: add the redwoodctl snippets to the Drive runbook (include the --force revoke example).
- Neha: publish the dashboard link and set the p95 alert thresholds as discussed.
- Marissa: send the T-24h notice to Acme Ops once the Drive link is final.
- Ryan: confirm the single canary shard we should target (shard-07) and whether you want OOB console access credentials shared ahead of the window.

I'll lock the maintenance task in Jira OPS-2147 and send an ICS to attendees after Ryan confirms shard-07. If anyone wants a quick 15-min preflight tomorrow morning to walk the steps, I'll host a call.

Rishi
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
